title: support postgresql host forms that have a colon in them but are not multihost format

labels.name: regression
labels.description: something worked and was broken by a change

labels.name: near-term release
labels.description: addition to the milestone which indicates this should be in a near-term release

body:
### Describe the bug

We use the [Cloud SQL Proxy](https://cloud.google.com/sql/docs/postgres/connect-auth-proxy#unix-sockets) to mount a connection on the local socket `/cloudsql/my-gcp-project:us-central1:mydbisnstance`. Per the docs, we specify the socket using the host parameter. However, it looks like point release 2.0.18 (I suspect in 6d5cdd1f59415ea8f08efe0f40126b8c384d1125) added a new feature for multiple hosts which breaks the existing connection string.

From semantic versioning, I would expect that 2.0.17 -> 2.0.18 to not break existing parsing.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

### Optional link from https://docs.sqlalchemy.org which documents the behavior that is expected

https://docs.sqlalchemy.org/en/20/dialects/postgresql.html#unix-domain-connections

### SQLAlchemy Version in Use

2.0.18

### DBAPI (i.e. the database driver)

psycopg2

### Database Vendor and Major Version

Postgresql

### Python Version

3.11

### Operating system

Linux

### To Reproduce

```python
# This code works in 2.0.17 and fails in 2.0.18
sqlalchemy.create_engine("postgresql://username@password/mydb?host=/cloudsql/my-gcp-project:us-central1:mydbisnstance")
```


### Error

```
File ~/.local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sqlalchemy/engine/create.py:617, in create_engine(url, **kwargs)
    614 dialect = dialect_cls(**dialect_args)
    616 # assemble connection arguments
--> 617 (cargs_tup, cparams) = dialect.create_connect_args(u)
    618 cparams.update(pop_kwarg("connect_args", {}))
    619 cargs = list(cargs_tup)  # allow mutability

File ~/.local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sqlalchemy/dialects/postgresql/_psycopg_common.py:134, in _PGDialect_common_psycopg.create_connect_args(self, url)
    131 def create_connect_args(self, url):
    132     opts = url.translate_connect_args(username="user", database="dbname")
--> 134     multihosts, multiports = self._split_multihost_from_url(url)
    136     if opts or url.query:
    137         if not opts:

File ~/.local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/sqlalchemy/dialects/postgresql/base.py:3124, in PGDialect._split_multihost_from_url(self, url)
   3118 if (
   3119     "port" not in url.query
   3120     and len(hosts) == 1
   3121     and ":" in hosts[0]
   3122 ):
   3123     integrated_multihost = True
-> 3124     h, p = hosts[0].split(":")
   3125     hosts = (h,)
   3126     ports = (p,) if p else (None,)
```
